race.comment: COMMANDO JACK (3) is the one to beat after missing by a head at Forbes last week as a short odds-on favourite, travelling well before being narrowly denied by Jade Division. His earlier BM58 failure at Mudgee was plain, but he has three wins around 1300m, handles wet ground and brings the strongest recent rating into this BM50. MS REEVES (8) is the clear danger, backing up quickly after placing seven days ago running third at Forbes, and looks a leading player again. COMMANDER MEROO (2) comes back from BM58 company after catching the eye late at Taree, and his 1300m record keeps him firmly in the winning discussion despite the gap between wins. EXTREME MERGER (4) drops out of BM58 grade and has 1300m wins, but two recent wide, well-beaten runs keep him in the roughie category.
